Krillion

How to play

Each prompt has hundreds of right answers. Type one before the clock runs out. A wrong answer costs nothing, so keep trying.

Obvious answers float near the surface. Rare ones sink you deeper: every point takes you 10 m down, and a perfect dive of 700 points reaches the trench at 7,000 m.

Every prompt hides one gem, the One in a Krillion. Watch out for Too Clever picks: they feel obscure, but everyone thinks of them.

The Daily Dive is the same 7 prompts for everyone, once a day. Endless Dive serves fresh dives back to back, Free Dive gives you 60 seconds to name as many answers as you can, and the Archive replays past days.
